goals.title: Send an email to my daughter
goals.picker_hint: One step at a time. You can pause anytime.
goals.step_text: On your phone or tablet, open your Mail app — it often looks like an envelope. Tap Compose or the pencil icon to start a new message.

goals.title: Join a video call with family
goals.picker_hint: One step at a time. You can pause anytime.
goals.step_text: Open the app you use for video calls, such as FaceTime or Zoom. Find the button to start a new call — it may say New call or show a camera with a plus sign.

goals.title: Find a photo on my phone
goals.picker_hint: One step at a time. You can pause anytime.
goals.step_text: Open your Photos app — it usually looks like a colorful flower or pinwheel. Scroll to look through your pictures, or tap Albums to see groups of photos.
